School Tours
We are delighted to invite prospective families to find out more about life at St. Edward's Primary School.
We are running school tours for prospective families to meet our fantastic team and see our wonderful school and Nursery in action on the following Mondays at 9:30 am:
5 October 2026
12 October 2026
19 October 2026
2 November 2026
9 November 2026
16 November 2026
23 November 2026
30 November 2026
7 December 2026
Please book your tour by calling the school or emailing the school office: office@stedwardsprimary.org
We encourage you to bring your children.
